name: byname
description: Language support for .pyn files, and .py files and Jupyter notebooks alongside them: bind-by-name Python, type-checked through basedpyright.

byname.serverCommand.description: Command that starts the server, e.g. ["uv", "run", "byname", "lsp"]. Default: <workspace>/.venv/bin/byname lsp, else byname lsp from PATH.

byname.checker.description: Type checker language server behind byname, e.g. ["pyrefly", "lsp"]. Default: basedpyright-langserver --stdio.

byname.outputOnSave.description: On save, write the plain-Python translation next to the file as <name>.pyn.py (e.g. for pasting into a judge).

byname.outputStripMain.description: Leave the `if __name__ == "__main__":` block out of <name>.pyn.py (LeetCode runs it otherwise).

byname.diagnosticsOnSave.description: Show errors for the saved text only: no new red squiggles while typing, they update on save.

byname.pythonDiagnostics.description: Show the checker's errors and warnings for .py files and plain notebooks. Off: they still get hover, completion and go to definition, plus syntax errors and faded unused code; check them with `byname tool basedpyright`. .pyn files and byname notebooks always show everything.
